player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely concluded the exploration by issuing "DONE" while in the Pantry, failing to check if all reachable directions from the current node and previously visited nodes had been fully explored. Specifically, upon returning to the Pantry, I should have verified if the "south" direction (which was available in the initial state) led to a new room or if any other unvisited connections existed in the graph. My strategy was flawed because I assumed the map was complete simply because I had returned to the start, rather than ensuring every available direction from every visited room had been traversed. Next time, I will maintain a strict checklist of untried directions for every room in my `nodes` list. I will only issue "DONE" when the set of available directions for the current room is empty AND every room in my `nodes` list has had all its possible directions explored. If I return to a room with untried directions (like "south" in the Pantry), I must take that direction instead of stopping.
